text.pannotiacompanion.config.title: Pannotia Companion
text.pannotiacompanion.config.option.max: How many homes each player can set in each dimension.
text.pannotiacompanion.config.option.hom: How long a player must stand still after using /pc home before being teleported. 20 ticks = 1 second.
How long a player must wait between uses of /pc home.
text.pannotiacompanion.config.option.spa: How long a player must stand still after using /pc spawn before being teleported. 20 ticks = 1 second.
How long a player must wait between uses of /pc spawn.
text.pannotiacompanion.config.option.sav: When enabled, /pc back can take a player to where they last died.
text.pannotiacompanion.config.option.bac: How long a player must stand still after using /pc back before being teleported. 20 ticks = 1 second.
How long a player must wait between uses of /pc back.
message.pannotiacompanion.cooldown: You can teleport again in %s seconds.
message.pannotiacompanion.hold_still: Hold still for %s seconds to teleport...
message.pannotiacompanion.home.none: You have no homes. Use /pc homes set [name] to make one.
message.pannotiacompanion.home.choose: You have several homes. Use /pc home <name> or pick one from /pc homes.
message.pannotiacompanion.home.name_take: You already have a home called %s.
message.pannotiacompanion.home.bad_name: Home names must be 1 to %s characters.
message.pannotiacompanion.home.limit: You can only have %s home(s) per dimension. Delete one or reuse a name.
message.pannotiacompanion.home.dimension: That home's dimension (%s) is not available.
message.pannotiacompanion.back.none: You have nowhere to go back to.
